title: Archive and Machine Again
author: Silas Zhou
blurb: Marguerite Iversen, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
